name: Moody Mule 8
author: Shakil-Babu
description: Rounded teal button that changes colour on hover.
howItWorks: On hover, border becomes 2px dashed #00BFA6, background-color changes from #00BFA6 to #fff, text color changes from #fff to #00BFA6.
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Moody Mule 8</title>
<style>
/* Moody Mule 8 by Shakil-Babu — https://uiverse.io/Shakil-Babu/moody-mule-8 */
.btn {
 background-color: #00BFA6;
 padding: 14px 40px;
 color: #fff;
 text-transform: uppercase;
 letter-spacing: 2px;
 cursor: pointer;
 border-radius: 10px;
 border: 2px dashed #00BFA6;
 box-shadow: rgba(50, 50, 93, 0.25) 0px 2px 5px -1px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 0px 1px 3px -1px;
 transition: .4s;
}

.btn span:last-child {
 display: none;
}

.btn:hover {
 transition: .4s;
 border: 2px dashed #00BFA6;
 background-color: #fff;
 color: #00BFA6;
}

.btn:active {
 background-color: #87dbd0;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button class="btn"> Hover me
</button>

</body>
</html>
